text:
Jo (Design): dropping a prototype image and short writeup for the compact "token glance" in the playground stream. goal: enough info at a glance (tokens used, regen/stop), minimal vertical space for smaller screens. mock: https://figma.redwood/proto/compact-token-glance :eyes:

Alex (Product): looks promising. question: does the bar show both total tokens and current message tokens? will it push the reply box when it grows?

Jo (Design): intention is two-line condensed: left = total tokens (small counter), center = streaming progress timeline (micro dots + ETA), right = affordance group (stop / regen / prompt insert). it should overlay the composer, not push it.

Meera (Eng): overlay is fine but be careful with focus traps. when streaming, keyboard nav needs to go composer -> controls -> messages. if overlay captures focus we break keyboard-only flows.

Sam (DevEx): also think about streaming accessibility: aria-live for partial responses, and a separate aria-label for the token widget like `Tokens used: 542, streaming in progress`. Pat can advise exact wording.

Pat (A11y): prefer: `aria-live="polite"` on streaming container, and token counter should have a descriptive label: `Tokens used: 542 (approx.)`. avoid live region flooding — only announce at start and when final token count posted. also ensure color contrast on the micro progress dots.

Jo (Design): noted — change plan: micro dots will be decorative, not live. we'll animate but keep `aria-hidden=true` on them. token count announced once at start (if >1000 say) and once on completion.

Meera (Eng): implementation nit: we should avoid per-char DOM updates. stream chunks update a single text node. token counter updates every 2s or on chunk boundary. batching like that keeps perf stable.

Alex (Product): UX question: stop vs pause vs interrupt language. our telemetry shows users expect stop to halt generation and keep partial output. pause implies resume. which do we want?

Jo (Design): leaning toward `Stop` (halts generation, keeps current text) and `Regenerate` (start over). add tooltip: "Stop generation (keeps current partial reply)". pause isn't surfaced.

Sam (DevEx): can we surface a shortened keyboard affordance? e.g., `Esc` for stop, and `Ctrl+Enter` for regenerate. include in hover text and in the command palette.

Meera (Eng): `Esc` is tricky with modals and other handlers. we can wire `Esc` when composer is focused and streaming state is active. will add guard rails.

Jo (Design): quick copy tweaks request: tooltip copy options: 1) "Stop generation — keep what's already generated" 2) "Stop generation (doesn't regenerate)" 3) Our current: "Stop generation (keeps partial output)" — lean to option 1 for clarity.

Pat (A11y): prefer 1 as well. also ensure tooltips are accessible via keyboard (focus target) and the tooltip text is available to screen readers (aria-describedby).

Alex (Product): prompt library flow: when user picks a prompt from the rail, do we inject as message or open a mini modal to edit first? feedback: users like quick insert but sometimes want to tweak. maybe a small inline editor popover.

Jo (Design): propose: click = quick insert (shows ephemeral toast: "Prompt inserted. Edit?" with an Edit button). long-press or `⌘K` variant opens inline editor. keeps happy path fast.

Sam (DevEx): add keyboard shortcut note in the mock: `P` to open prompt palette, `Enter` to insert, `E` to edit. keep conflicts in mind.

Meera (Eng): engineering checklist: 1) overlay token bar responsive for <480px, 2) batch token counter updates (2s), 3) streaming live region polite & throttled, 4) `Esc` stop only during streaming when composer focused, 5) prompt insert events tracked for analytics.

Jo (Design): thanks — I'll push updated frames with the a11y annotations and a small gif of the streaming + stop flow. aiming to ship an experiment to internal beta next week.

deploy-bot: deploy queued for playground/ux/compact-token-glance experiment at 2024-06-11T18:45:00Z :rocket:

Alex (Product): awesome — @Jo please ping when frames are up. leaving small microcopy nit: replace "regenerate" tooltip with "Regenerate from scratch" to avoid ambiguity.

Jo (Design): done — updated copy and uploaded new pngs. will share link in a sec. :thumbsup:
